svg.title: MOVE ON intro — draw the M so it sits on the scooter
svg.desc: Drag the points of "m-left" and "m-right" until the M lies exactly on the scooter. Keep them as two separate paths, do not add or delete paths, and save as SVG. Turn on the "photo" layer if you need the real photo underneath. Coordinates are the photo's own pixels (844 x 1500).
